Chapter 992: Chapter 9 Refining the Jade Gourd (Subscribe Please)

Sigh!

Lin Yuan gently closed his eyes as the last symbol rune slowly dissipated.

At this moment, the universe inside the jade gourd was utterly empty.

Not a single symbol rune floated any longer.

“Three thousand three hundred thirty-three types of internal universe structures…”

In Lin Yuan’s mind, many details of the symbol runes emerged; he had now thoroughly comprehended all the runes.

“No wonder one needs to comprehend all three thousand three hundred thirty-three symbol runes to pass the test.”

Lin Yuan pondered with a thought.

The three thousand three hundred thirty-three symbol runes represented the same number of universe construction methods.

In fact, after fully understanding them,

Lin Yuan faintly realized that these methods of universe construction complemented and fitted together perfectly.

The universe that could ultimately be constructed would reach some unimaginably high degree.

“This is the foundation, the real foundation.”

Lin Yuan’s eyes widened in astonishment; an internal universe within the Path Splitting Realm, nearly on par with that of a Chaos Venerable—whose foundation could compare?

“This is too incredible.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread out. With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he had only barely managed to decipher the mysteries within the runes after spending a great deal of mental effort and energy.

But if it were like the being that created the jade gourd, able to concoct these methods of universe construction out of thin air… at least for now, Lin Yuan saw no hope in managing to do so, not with more time or any possibility of completion.

Of course, the main reason was that Lin Yuan’s life level had not reached that height; it was his realm that limited his Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

“Is this a tier-thirteen temporal lifeform?”

Lin Yuan mused internally. Although various messages conveyed by the jade gourd and the words revealed by the girl in red never mentioned the creator’s level of power,

Lin Yuan was very certain that the creator of the jade gourd was not something even a supreme Chaos Great Saint could compare with.

A tier-thirteen temporal lifeform could already see through many timelines, know parts of the past, present, and future; their vision was fundamentally different from other lifeforms.

Whoosh!

While Lin Yuan was still immersed in the many runes he had just comprehended, the girl in red appeared before him in an instant.

“Have you contemplated these symbol runes before?”

The girl in red could not help but ask.

The symbol runes within the jade gourd were left by its creator, and logically, there should be no leaks whatsoever. At most, one or two symbol runes might resemble those born naturally from the Chaos Void.

But one or two resemblances might accelerate understanding, could all the runes be similar?

That’s why the girl in red asked.

Compared to the leakage of symbol imprints, Lin Yuan spending just a year to thoroughly understand what the founder of the jade gourd had left behind for an entire Cosmic Era seemed more plausible.

The girl in red still felt the possibility of rune leakage was higher?

“Encountered these runes before?” Lin Yuan was slightly startled, then immediately shook his head and said, “No, this is also my first time seeing these runes; they’re too amazing.”

Lin Yuan spoke with admiration. Only after understanding these runes did he realize how difficult it was to create them and what level of essence the universe must attain.

“You are quite amazing too,” the girl in red said after a moment of silence.

The creator of the jade gourd was amazing because it was a great temporal lifeform that could see through the past and future, knowing the birth to the destruction of countless universes, thus able to forge so many universe construction methods.

But Lin Yuan?

The girl in red did not know Lin Yuan’s exact strength or realm, but she was very sure he was not of the thirteenth tier, not even of the Chaos Realm.

Such a youngster, in just one year, had comprehended all the runes, causing the girl in red’s understanding to nearly collapse.

“What should I do now?”

Lin Yuan inquired.

Now that he had comprehended all the symbols,

What was he supposed to do next?

“Since you’ve already comprehended all the runes, you naturally can go ahead and refine the jade gourd,”

said the girl in red.

Although it was unbelievably quick for Lin Yuan to comprehend the runes, comprehension was comprehension, meeting the standard to refine the jade gourd.

And after refining the jade gourd, he would be able to acquire the complete foundational inheritance within.

This inheritance, once cultivated to the extreme, would make one’s foundation incredibly profound; absorbing seven colors of liquid would cause the internal universe to expand to twenty-three times its original size.

So, after cultivating this foundational inheritance, how much more vast would one’s internal universe be compared to others at the same level of life?

“Refine the jade gourd?”

Lin Yuan tried to extend the power of his internal universe into the jade gourd.

But he found that he could not touch the Origin Source of the jade gourd at all.

“With the current power of your internal universe, you naturally cannot refine the jade gourd,” said the girl in red, noticing Lin Yuan’s attempt at refinement, and immediately spoke: “You must integrate all three thousand three hundred thirty-three symbol runes, with the universe construction methods they contain, into your own internal universe before you can refine the jade gourd.”

Only after integrating the internal universe construction within all the runes would the internal universe undergo a fundamental transformation. Only then would he have the foundation to refine the jade gourd.

“Don’t worry, there’s no time limit, you can take it slow,”

the girl in red explained.

According to the standards left by the creator of the jade gourd, understanding the runes must be confined within a single Cosmic Era, while integrating all symbol runes into one’s own internal universe had no such restrictions.

Be it one Cosmic Era or ten, all was fine.

“Even though you have not yet refined the jade gourd, you can still manage to control some of its functions and can send me into your internal universe to guide you on how to integrate the universe construction faster and better,”

the girl in red immediately said.

The construction of the universe is incredibly vast and complicated; a slight alteration could potentially set off a domino effect, causing the entire universe to begin collapsing.
